summation.displayName: IRAK-2 has two TRAF6 binding motifs that are responsible for...
summation.text: IRAK-2 has two TRAF6 binding motifs that are responsible for initiating TRAF6 signaling transduction (Ye H et al 2002). IRAK2 point mutants with mutated TRAF6-binding motifs abrogate NFkB activation and are incapable to stimulate TRAF6 ubiquitination (Keating SE et al 2007).
